title: Twenty-Two Thousand on the Terminal Floor

mood.label: Uneasy, danger leading
mood.summary: Hormuz turned into open exchange and oil closed near $91; Krakatau stranded 22,000 in Jakarta; a wedding fire in DR Congo; nearly 9,000 dead in Lebanon. Against that, a rocket reached orbit from Norway. Danger leads, the good is small and real.

lines: Twenty-two thousand asleep on the terminal floor,
the mountain had its own opinion of the sky.
Two hundred and nine departures crossed out in red —
nobody argues with ash, they just wait to fly.
Ninety-one a barrel, the strait pulled shut,
tankers burning where the shipping lanes bend.
Off a cold Norwegian coast something held its line
and went the whole way up. Small. Real. It counts.
So we tally what got through and what got taken,
one door open down a corridor of closed.
Danger leads; the good arrives anyway —
uneasy, still awake, still holding the boarding pass.
